What's new in 0.1.89:
- Connection setup (In development): clearer direct-connection checks, permission before automatic router setup, and warnings before changing the server port. The Android connection page needs compatible apps; relay backup also needs matching server support.
- Audiobooks: moving the seek slider keeps your preview while the sleep timer updates. Releasing outside the slider or cancelling clears that preview.
- Radio search waits when Enter finishes a typed character. Podcast suggestions stay visible when dismissal fails, so you can retry.
- Privacy tightening for signed-in photo-map images, cover art, subtitles, Space Saver thumbnails, story pictures and story audio, including images through the Jellyfin-compatible interface.
- Device checks, Oct 18, 2026, 7:23 AM Eastern: signed upgrade, launch, movie-library display and release notes passed. Windows playback, changed features, in-app updating, real-router and away-from-home checks remain untested.
- Release source commit f3714216169ff9eda5c487bf928dea86d889917f.
- Published: Oct 18, 2026, 7:06 AM Eastern.
